item.title: Chikatetsu Fuusa Jiken "Naze Boku-tachi wa Koko ni Iru"
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Lune loves K
  • 発売日: 2004-10-29
  • スコア: 6.35/10 (10 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 地下鉄封鎖事件「なぜ僕たちはここにいる」
  • 英語名: Chikatetsu Fuusa Jiken “Naze Boku-tachi wa Koko ni Iru”

あらすじ

Main character is a normal university student. He goes to a part-time job before Christmas and gets in a subway crash. He wakes up in a closed space with another man and four women as survivors. They strive to escape this place, but somehow things get violent with many women insulted. Will protagonist help the girls or attack them?

item.title: Rinkan Gakuen "Yamete! ...Okaa-san, Minaide!"
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Lune loves K
  • 発売日: 2004-03-26
  • スコア: 7.0/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 輪奸学園「やめてっ！…お母さん、見ないで！」
  • 英語名: Rinkan Gakuen “Yamete! …Okaa-san, Minaide!”

あらすじ

Main character is in charge of the elite class in the prestigious school. He uses his chemistry knowledge to drug students and turn them into meat slaves forming his harem. This spring there’s a new beautiful student who transfers together with her mother as health teacher. Protagonist welcomes a new challenge.
